title: DvargoshModuleRegistrySchema
description: Comprehensive AST metadata and lint specification for Dvargosh modules, domains, and exported services.

lint_rules.name: DomainNamingConvention
lint_rules.description: Domain tags must follow <module_name>:<subsystem> or wildcard '*'.

lint_rules.name: SecuredMemoryGuardCheck
lint_rules.description: Hardware-guarded secured memory space must not exceed 64 MB (65536 KB) per module without elevated quota.

lint_rules.name: SignatureVerificationEnforced
lint_rules.description: All dynamic shared library modules must be cryptographically signed via HMAC-SHA256 prior to loading.

lint_rules.name: TypeSafeProxyAvailability
lint_rules.description: Every exported DVARGOSH_SERVICE function should have an auto-generated strongly-typed proxy wrapper.

modules.name: demo_pkg
modules.description: Full Demo Package with Subsystems (Domains) and Inter-Subsystem Access Control
modules.author: Dvargosh Team

services.name: demo_pkg_vault_hash
services.description: Auto-registered SHA256 hashing function in vault subsystem
services.hover_tooltip:
### Dvargosh Service: `demo_pkg_vault_hash`
* **Domain**: `demo_pkg:vault`
* **Description**: Auto-registered SHA256 hashing function in vault subsystem
* **RPC Invocation**:
```cpp
ctx.registry()->invoke("demo_pkg_vault_hash", {args});
```
* **Direct Typed Call**:
```cpp
DemoPkgProxy::demo_pkg_vault_hash(ctx, args);
```
* **AutoMapper Binding**:
```cpp
auto fn = mapper.bind<ReturnType, ...>("demo_pkg_vault_hash");
```
